ev.q: Persons living in flooded homes were significantly more likely than those living in nonflooded homes to report illness
Fifty-four (12.9%) surveyed households reported at least one person with illness
A total of 137 (32.6%) surveyed households had floodwaters in the home
Persons living in flooded homes were significantly more likely than those living in nonflooded homes to report illness
Data were stratified by census tract for calculation of illness and injury odds ratios for living in a flooded versus nonflooded home.
HDHHS conducted the survey door to door on June 16, 2001
